hints.tr: Birden fazla cümleli bir yordam `BEGIN ... END` içine alınıyor. Önce kontrol: `IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE id = @order_id AND status = 'pending') THROW ...;`, sonra `UPDATE`.
hints.en: A procedure with more than one statement goes inside `BEGIN ... END`. The check first: `IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE id = @order_id AND status = 'pending') THROW ...;`, then the `UPDATE`.

hints.tr: `THROW`'dan önceki cümle noktalı virgülle bitmeli; yoksa `Incorrect syntax near 'THROW'`. `THROW` çalışınca yordam orada duruyor, `UPDATE`'e hiç gelinmiyor.
hints.en: The statement before `THROW` has to end with a semicolon; otherwise `Incorrect syntax near 'THROW'`. When `THROW` runs, the procedure stops there and never reaches the `UPDATE`.

checks.query: SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @err INT = 0; BEGIN TRY EXEC dbo.ship_order 1001; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SET @err = ERROR_NUMBER(); END CATCH; EXEC dbo.ship_order 1004; SELECT @err AS error_on_shipped, (SELECT status FROM orders WHERE id = 1004) AS status_after;
